episodes.title: Undan jöklinum
episodes.summary: A year after Katla's eruption, the shattered survivors are still grappling with the aftermath. Suddenly, an ash-caked woman appears on the glacier.

episodes.title: Ása
episodes.summary: Emerging from the shadows, a surprise visitor gets Gríma's full attention. As the ground beneath them shifts, Darri and Gunhild heed Katla's call.

episodes.title: Móðirin
episodes.summary: The cold, cruel reality of life in Vík í Mýrdal comes home to Gríma. Darri studies his strange discovery in secret. Gunhild confronts the newcomer.

episodes.title: Þetta er ekki hann
episodes.summary: Is this a dream or a nightmare? Unsettled, Gríma returns to the camp for answers while Darri heads to Vík for a reunion. A torn Þór grows enthralled.

episodes.title: Norðanátt
episodes.summary: A shocking revelation that would ordinarily offer closure instead opens up a chasm of questions. History repeats itself as a deadly ash storm gathers.

episodes.title: Gríma
episodes.summary: Face to face with an utter mystery, Gríma tries to understand her shadowy find. Rakel has a change of heart as Gísli deals with an unexpected arrival.

episodes.title: Steinninn
episodes.summary: Sometimes shadows have minds of their own. At the scene of the accident, Rakel pours her heart out to Gríma. Darri canvases the crevasse for answers.

episodes.title: Ég er þú
episodes.summary: What's real, what isn't — and does it matter? The truth comes out, the fear grows and the mystery threatens to sweep away everything before it.
